claims.statement: The paper described Tom Allen as the heavy-weight champion.
claims.excerpt: Tom Allen, the heavy-weight |champion quotes 7 tq 4 Sullivan

claims.statement: Tom Allen predicted Sullivan would win in 20 to 30 rounds, McAuliffe in 25 rounds and Dixon in 10 rounds in the New Orleans fights of September 1892.
Tom Allen quoted betting odds of 7 to 4 on Sullivan, 5 to 4 on McAuliffe and 3 to 1 on Dixon for the New Orleans fights.

notes: Expert predictions from the Inter Ocean circular. The prediction line is 'Tem Allen, ex-heavy-weight champion' on the line above the excerpt, and the excerpt begins with garbled 'illivan' (Sullivan). Round counts are read as the rounds in which each man wins. The 3-1 Dixon odds are OCR '3-i'. The hint's 'quote' is the printed prediction, not direct speech, so no quote is recorded.
